Chapter 1081: 18 Changes In The Inner Universe (Please Subscribe)_3

Chapter 1081: Chapter 18 Changes in the Inner Universe (Please Subscribe)_3

Lin Yuan looked at ‘Cang Yulong’ and casually asked, “What are your plans for the future?”

“While my true body was still alive, I secretly established a faction, with a Sovereign presiding over it. I plan to bring him to join that faction…”

‘Cang Yulong’ replied honestly.

“That is excellent.”

Lin Yuan nodded and did not pursue the matter further.

…

In the boundless Chaos Void.

‘Cang Yulong’ gazed into the distance, his eyes shifting, as a certain aura began to retract.

“What is happening to me?”

Cang Yulong abruptly snapped out of his reverie, looking around in confusion.

“Stop searching.”

A childlike voice resonated within the depths of his soul, “Your predecessor has already left, along with all of your clansmen—they’re now within the internal universe.”

“The predecessor has left?”

“Did the predecessor make things difficult for you?”

Cang Yulong asked cautiously.

“Not at all.”

The childlike voice sighed with some emotion, “This Sovereign, who shares a unique affinity with your Stone People Clan, has a very good temperament. Otherwise, we’d all be doomed.”

It was commendable that Lin Yuan remained unmoved after detecting that the childlike voice originated from a Great Saint Soul Fragment.

The Great Saint Soul Fragment might not be powerful, but it carried a significant portion of a Great Saint’s memories, making it an irresistible temptation for most Sovereigns.

What the childlike voice did not realize, however, was that Lin Yuan simply did not want to waste time on him.

If Lin Yuan had forcibly kept him, the childlike voice would surely have resisted. Furthermore, given that Soul Search wasn’t an option, the act held little value for Lin Yuan.

Other Sovereigns might be willing to haggle because of their slow progress, but with Lin Yuan’s speed of cultivation—from Dao Convergence to Chaos Realm—he faced virtually no major bottlenecks.

“Stop dawdling. Set off now for the Void Domain I mentioned.”

At the urging of the childlike voice, Cang Yulong immediately got moving but couldn’t resist asking, “Will I ever have the chance to meet the predecessor again?”

“Meet the predecessor again?”

The childlike voice fell into contemplation, “Meeting such a mighty figure too many times would mean your soul and intentions become as bare as naked walls. Do you really wish to reunite?”

The childlike voice continued, “If you truly want to meet him again, you’ll need to reach the Chaos Realm—at the very least, become a Sovereign. Only then will you have the qualifications to meet him.”

“With the strength of the Chaos Realm, coupled with the legacy I’ve imparted to you, even if you meet him again, you’ll have the ability to protect yourself. It would also put my worries to rest.”

“Chaos Realm?”

Cang Yulong’s expression barely held steady, as uncertainty clouded his heart about when he might attain such a realm.

…

The ancient Chaos Continent.

The ‘Fragmented World’ of Star Tears.

After Lin Yuan properly settled the Stone People Clan within human civilization, he began to comprehend the crystal-clear stone he acquired.

The stone contained the partial cultivation memories of a Great Saint, which Lin Yuan valued greatly.

He studied the stone for a moment before releasing a thread of his soul to permeate within it.

In an instant.

Lin Yuan’s consciousness entered a vast, boundless world.

This should also be within the Chaos Void; in the distant horizon, endless streams of Chaos Qi floated about.

And at the center of Lin Yuan’s perspective sat a colossal figure cross-legged.

This enormous figure emanated an aura so profound, that even a trace of it could crush an entire universe.

No, it wasn’t an “as if”—it truly was. The slightest release of its aura could cause a universe birthed within the Chaos Void to enter premature destruction.

“So, this is the power of a Great Saint?”

Lin Yuan’s heart trembled. For the first time, he was experiencing the true essence of a Great Saint’s power so directly.

Neither Xuanhuang nor the Moyu Tower Master—what Lin Yuan had seen of them were mere imprints, far removed from the genuine strength of these peerless Great Saints.

As for the Shadow Demon Great Saint and Nine Phoenix Great Saint? Lin Yuan had only ever felt the aftershocks of their battle from afar. No more than that.

What followed.

In the scene Lin Yuan witnessed, the massive figure began cultivating.

If the image had merely been a replay, Lin Yuan might have found it dull and tiresome, but what he saw now was the vivid memory of actual cultivation.

The experiences of this immense figure during its cultivation were completely synchronized with Lin Yuan.

“So this is how the Chaos Void appears in the eyes of a Great Saint?”

Lin Yuan immersed himself in these insights, his mind continuously flooded with realizations.

[Your innate perception is extraordinary; by observing an unknown being’s cultivation process, your personal cultivation insights have been enhanced…]

Lin Yuan was wholly entranced, studying the cultivation of a Great Saint.

Who knew how much time had passed?

Eventually, Lin Yuan slowly pulled himself out.

“These cultivation memories are of incredible benefit to me.”

A smile surfaced on Lin Yuan’s face. Not every Great Saint was willing to share their cultivation memories.

Because if the memories fell into the hands of their enemies, it would very likely reveal their weaknesses and flaws.

Only Great Saints on the cusp of ascending to the Thirteenth Tier dared to take such risks.

Upon reaching the Thirteenth Tier, should they fail, it was inconsequential if others exploited their weaknesses. But if they succeeded, they would transcend into Tier-Thirteen timeless life forms, making it irrelevant even if their flaws became common knowledge across the Chaos Void.

“Hm?”

“Has that inheritance space been refined?”

A trace of movement flickered across Lin Yuan’s expression.

While comprehending the Great Saint’s cultivation memories, Lin Yuan had concurrently been refining the inheritance space.

With the help of ‘Cang Yulong’ and the cooperative Great Saint Soul Fragment, Lin Yuan encountered nearly no difficulties and quickly claimed dominion over it.

Realizing this, Lin Yuan promptly directed his consciousness into the inherited space.

“Chaos Tree.”

Gazing deep into the inherited space, Lin Yuan focused on the Chaos Tree—a most prized treasure within this realm. A top-tier Twelve-Star natural marvel.

Even Lin Yuan greatly coveted it.

“Time to plant it into my internal universe.”

Lin Yuan immediately proceeded to ‘transplant’ the Chaos Tree.

Rustle!

The Chaos Tree spread far and wide, blotting out the sky, but Lin Yuan’s internal universe was vaster and more stable.

Before long.

The Chaos Tree rooted itself within Lin Yuan’s internal universe.

Buzzing sounds filled the air!

The moment the Chaos Tree took root fully, an earth-shattering transformation began unfolding within Lin Yuan’s internal universe.
